headline: Colombian Restaurant Association Warns of Wave of Closures
summary: The Colombian restaurant association Acoga reported that 5,000 restaurants closed by October, with industry groups warning that up to 6,500 food establishments could shut down in 2026 amid rising payroll and input costs.
why: Sector-wide closures highlight inflationary pressures, labor costs, and consumer spending challenges within the domestic hospitality and retail economy.

impacts.name: Consumer Discretionary
impacts.why: Rising operating costs leading to business closures indicate stress in the hospitality sector.
